Ticket:
Help with staff credential resets and security policy settings

Hello support team, I am so sorry to bother you with this, but we are having a bit of trouble with a couple of our staff accounts this morning. Three of our medical assistants got locked out after their passwords expired, and whenever I try to reset them from the main admin settings, it gives me an error code. Also, our practice partners want us to tighten up our overall security policies—specifically requiring stronger complexity rules and forcing everyone to change their credentials every ninety days. Could you please walk me through where those specific policy toggles are hiding in the dashboard? So sorry again for taking up your time with this administrative housekeeping.
